fields.Name: ORD-33 - Entitlement Read
fields.Description: The LXP ask/answer against a real provider. EN1-EN15 prove grants are written; ER1-ER7 prove Orders.CheckEntitlement and ListEntitlements evaluate them in-process (ClassFactory Execute). Sister GraphQL coverage is the wire-entitlements client bundle.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: After confirm, Check by PersonID and Email is Granted; unknown person and unknown email share the NoGrant shape; org-only grants are invisible to a person Check; elapsed ValidTo is Expired even though stored Status is still Active; an elapsed subscription term is Expired at Check, not a poll of Active; ListEntitlements is the library and IncludeInactive=false drops expired codes; a missing Code is an envelope failure.
